meta_description:
4,666 likes, 67 comments - earthpix on October 20, 2026: "Le Procope opened in 1686 and is often called the oldest café in Paris. ⁠
⁠
Over the centuries, it welcomed Voltaire, Rousseau, Victor Hugo, and, according to legend, a young Napoleon who couldn’t settle his bill!⁠
⁠
Instead of cash, he left his hat… and never came back for it. Today, the hat is still on display by the entrance.⁠
⁠
By: @restaurantprocope1686".
